from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialEntry(BaseModel):
    """One financial figure extracted from a document relevant to the task."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Legal name of the entity in this filing")
    fiscal_year: str | None = Field(description="The fiscal year the figure applies to")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The label of the reported line item (e.g. 'Net Income', 'Net Loss')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="Reported amount as signed float; negative indicates loss")
    continuing_operations_context: str | None = Field(description="Context confirming if this figure represents Continuing Operations (e.g., 'No discontinued operations listed')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_entries: list[FinancialEntry]
